nodes.description: Public token name string of the ZEROxBTCHate token.
Public token symbol string of the ZEROxBTCHate token.
Public token decimals, set to 18.
Public mapping address => uint256 holding token balances, credited in IHate0xBTC and mutated in transfer/transferFrom.
Public nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 of approved allowances.
Public mapping uint => bool used as a 'mined' flag keyed by keccak256 of the hate reason string.
Public total supply counter, incremented by 10**18 on every newly mined hate string.
Modifier that asserts msg.sender is not the zero address before executing the guarded function.
Public 'mining' function: hashes the reason string, flags it in ZEROxBTCHaters, mints 10**18 to msg.sender, emits 100 Transfer events from a fixed address, and increases totalSupply.
Public token transfer guarded by validAddress; subtracts _value from the caller balance and adds it to _to.
Public allowance-based transfer guarded by validAddress; moves _value from _from to _to and decrements the caller allowance.
Public approval function guarded by validAddress that sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Caller address; used as reward recipient, balance key, allowance owner/spender and access-control subject.
Unchecked balance credit of 10**18 to the caller inside IHate0xBTC (arithmetic overflow risk).
Unchecked totalSupply increment inside IHate0xBTC; the comment claims overflow is impossible but no guard exists (arithmetic).
Unchecked subtraction from the sender balance in transfer (only a pre-require on balance).
Addition to the recipient balance in transfer, guarded by a stale-invariant require.
Unchecked subtraction from the _from balance in transferFrom.
Addition to the _to balance in transferFrom (arithmetic).
Decrement of the caller allowance for _from in transferFrom (arithmetic).
User-supplied hate reason string that is hashed and used as the mining key.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Local uint holding keccak256(bytes(reason)), used as the ZEROxBTCHaters key.
Loop counter for the 100-iteration Transfer event emission loop.
Named boolean return variable of transfer.
Named boolean return variable of transferFrom.
Named boolean return variable of approve.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient of the mined hate-token reward inside IHate0xBTC.
msg.sender is used as the balanceOf key credited in IHate0xBTC.
The reason string parameter is consumed by IHate0xBTC.
reason is hashed into the local hash variable.
The local hash is used as the key written into ZEROxBTCHaters.
IHate0xBTC writes the ZEROxBTCHaters flag for the supplied reason hash.
IHate0xBTC increases the totalSupply state variable.
IHate0xBTC performs an unchecked balance credit of 10**18 to msg.sender.
Unchecked addition mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and can overflow.
IHate0xBTC increments totalSupply with no overflow guard despite the comment claiming safety.
Unchecked totalSupply += 10**18 arithmetic write.
The local loop counter i drives the 100-iteration Transfer emission loop in IHate0xBTC.
The _to parameter is consumed by transfer.
The _value parameter is consumed by transfer.
msg.sender is the implicit source of funds in transfer.
transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transfer executes an unchecked subtraction from the sender balance.
transfer executes an addition to the recipient balance.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
_value is added to balanceOf[_to].
Unchecked subtraction can underflow the sender balance entry.
Addition can overflow the recipient balance entry.
transfer is guarded by the validAddress modifier.
validAddress asserts msg.sender != 0, an access-control style check on the caller.
msg.sender identifies the balance entry debited in transfer.
The _from parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
The _to parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
The _value parameter is consumed by transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom subtracts _value from the _from balance.
transferFrom adds _value to the _to balance.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance for _from.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from].
_value is added to balanceOf[_to].
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender].
Unchecked subtraction can underflow the _from balance entry.
Addition can overflow the _to balance entry.
Subtraction can underflow the allowance entry, corrupting the allowance invariant.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key used in approve and as spender in transferFrom, controlling authorization.
msg.sender acts as the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
transferFrom is guarded by the validAddress modifier.
The _spender parameter is consumed by approve.
The _value parameter is consumed by approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
approve is guarded by the validAddress modifier.

normalization_plan.reason: The reason string parameter only feeds IHate0xBTC hashing and event emission; fold it into the function signature.
transfer._to is a transient argument of transfer; normalize into the transfer function node.
transfer._value is a transient argument of transfer; normalize into the transfer function node.
transferFrom._from is a transient argument of transferFrom; normalize into the transferFrom function node.
transferFrom._to is a transient argument of transferFrom; normalize into the transferFrom function node.
transferFrom._value is the amount consumed by the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic operations.
approve._spender is a transient argument of approve; normalize into the approve function node.
approve._value is a transient argument of approve; normalize into the approve function node.
The local hash exists only to index ZEROxBTCHaters inside IHate0xBTC; normalize into the owning function.
The local loop counter i is scoped to the IHate0xBTC emit loop; normalize into the owning function.
The named return variable success belongs to transfer; normalize into the transfer function node.
The named return variable success belongs to transferFrom; normalize into the transferFrom function node.
The named return variable success belongs to approve; normalize into the approve function node.
